storage: Exact ordinary INTEGER global leaves or captured private computed USING leaves; no source copy-back or synthetic public roots
identity: Selector captured once; nested reference aliases share scalar storage; independent copies and fresh entries differ
progress: Checkpoint elapsed milliseconds, fractional carry, backward-clock and storage checks; all timer updates preflight before publication
lifetime: Private captures survive lexical exit and ordinary source returns; explicit disconnect or task terminal cleanup releases registrations; linked invocation timers end with their invocation
initialization: Validate initialized storage before clock; missing INTEGER becomes zero only after a valid clock; invalid initial values or clock preserve storage and registrations
counter_guard: Conservative lexical whole-root timer/counter exclusion, including sibling leaves and nested aliases; independent private copies remain separate
persistence: Declared data and logical services only; no private captures, timer connections, clocks, callbacks or suspended stacks
boundary: Declared routine locals/formals, narrow/REAL/CONFIG/resource timers, direct uncaptured computed selectors, physical timing, native interrupts and public strict mode remain outside this policy
